messages:
Josh (Designer): sharing a quick mock — thinking about moving the crypto affordance out of the main row into a compact pill on the right to reduce visual noise. screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/abc123 :eyes:
Michelle (PM): curious — does that change the visual priority for region selection? customers often expect region first then key type.
Josh (Designer): true. Current mock has [Region] > [Retention] > [Encryption]. Proposal is [Retention] collapsed, then Region, then a small 'Key' pill. Mobile might need a different ordering.
Anika (Frontend): from an implementation POV, moving the pill is fine, but we need consistent focus order for keyboard users. If the pill is visually last, it still needs to be reachable in tab order after region.
Sam (UX): copy thought: instead of "Encryption: BYOK / Redwood", maybe "Key ownership: Customer-managed / Redwood-managed" — clearer for non-crypto folks. Also avoid acronym-first labels.
Eli (Security): +1 on explicit wording. Also we should show a short hover tooltip for what BYOK implies: "Customer provides key (BYOK) — we don't have plaintext access."
Tara (A11y): contrast nit — the pill's border is 2px #D6E1FF on a #FFFFFF background; fails AA at small sizes. Need to bump to #AEC8FF or add 1px solid focus outline on keyboard focus.
Josh (Designer): good call. I'll update colors. Also thinking about an aria-label for the pill: aria-label="Key ownership, currently Redwood-managed, opens key settings" — is that too verbose?
Anika (Frontend): that aria-label looks ok but avoid the word "opens" if the pill triggers a menu. Use: `aria-haspopup="menu"` + `aria-label="Key ownership: Redwood‑managed"`. Code snippet: ```html
<button class="key-pill" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Key ownership: Redwood‑managed">Redwood-managed</button>
```
Sam (UX): love the shorter label. Also for retention we should surface the actual days in the compact state: e.g., "Retention: 30 days" so people don't have to open a drawer.
Michelle (PM): product question — if region selection changes, does audit-log language need to reflect region-scoped events? e.g., "Updated encryption setting for eu-west-1" vs generic "Updated encryption".
Eli (Security): yes, make audit events explicit with region context when available. We should also standardize verb tense: prefer past simple: "Changed key ownership to Customer-managed (BYOK)." Avoid ambiguous "Updated" alone.
Josh (Designer): small microcopy suggestion for audit: "Changed key ownership — Customer-managed (BYOK)". Might be long in the row, maybe truncate in UI but full text in detail drawer.
Tara (A11y): audit log rows should expose `role="list"` / `role="listitem"` and ensure screen reader sees the timestamp before the verb. Right now DOM places timestamp last which reads awkwardly.
Anika (Frontend): easy fix — reorder DOM to timestamp first but visually float it right with CSS. Will file a PR.
Sam (UX): language for timezone in audit: spell out timezone for cross-region teams: "2024-04-02 15:12 UTC" rather than local timezone-only. Keeps logs unambiguous.
Michelle (PM): agree. Also a small ask: can the region picker sort by "nearest -> farthest" for users in multi-regions? That may reduce mistakes where people choose wrong region.
Eli (Security): sorting by latency is fine for ergonomics but we must keep an explicit label stating the actual region identifier (e.g., "eu-west-1") — not just "Europe".
Josh (Designer): will add ID and human label: "Europe (eu-west-1)".
Anika (Frontend): one more nit — the key status dot uses green #2ECC71 for Redwood-managed and orange #FFB84D for customer keys pending rotation. Orange contrast low with white dot. Suggest filled circle + label text to help color-blind users.
Tara (A11y): yes please. Never rely on color alone. Add an icon + aria-hidden text, and a visually available label.
Sam (UX): final microcopy tweak for the pill menu: header should read "Key settings" not "Crypto settings" — less jargon.
Josh (Designer): thanks all — I'll push updated mock and include a developer spec: tab order, aria attributes, audit copy strings, and mobile differences.
deploy-bot: Posted a new build artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/app/crypto-pill-v3 (for QA) :rocket:
Anika (Frontend): grabbing QA artifact now, will put up a short PR with the DOM reorder + aria changes.
Michelle (PM): timeline: can we get this to staging by next Tues? We need it for the compliance demo on Wed.
Josh (Designer): aiming for Monday EOD. If anything blocks, flag here. :thumbsup:
